tagline: Self-hosted PHP email campaign and newsletter manager with bounce handling and queue throttling.
description: phpList sends email campaigns and newsletters from a server you run. It is a PHP application that needs MySQL or MariaDB and Apache, and the system requirements page asks for PHP 8.1 or later with a list of extensions. You upload the release files to your web root, create a database, edit the config file and finish in a browser installer. A Docker image is also published. The feature list covers subscriber import from CSV and Excel with attributes, personalised messages, scheduling and requeueing, bounce processing, domain-based throttling and built-in support for Amazon SES. It can also read RSS feeds and send their content on a schedule, or send a web page as the message body. It is licensed under the AGPL. The project also runs a hosted service at phplist.com, free to start, with data migration between the two. As a Mailchimp replacement it covers lists, campaigns, analytics and bounces. The feature list does not describe a visual automation builder, and upgrades are done by hand with a database backup and file copy.
strengths: Imports and exports subscribers as CSV or Excel, including attributes
Bounce processing with policy and regex-based rules
Queue management with domain-based throttling for large sends
Built-in Amazon SES support and an RSS-to-email feed
limits: Upgrades are manual: back up the database, copy files, run the upgrade page
Needs Apache and a PHP extension list; no single-binary install
The feature list shows no visual automation builder or drag-and-drop email designer
The old Dressprow theme is not currently maintained
bestFor: A small organisation with a PHP host and a mailing list that wants control over bounces and sending speed.
